source.note: 540 Prophet plans ingested; 105 have close-price history for charts.

content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body: $PPLI needs 42 for the breakout. Below 34.9, the base is gone.
Jobless claims are averaging 200k a week this month, 11.0% below a year ago. Growth data remains roughly steady.
$NWE closed at 74, its first 52-week closing high since Jun 2026.
$PEB has held the post-spike average at 18.3 for 13 sessions.

queue.headline: $NWS has the six-month volume shelf underneath.
queue.body: Below 30.2, that shelf is gone.

queue.headline: $CHRW sits below its six-month volume anchor
queue.body: The busiest price in that window is 150. Below it, the prior structure is gone.
$TNDM is 2.1% below 16.2, the past six months' most-traded price.
$ESE sits 14.4% below 300, the six-month most-traded price.
$PPL reclaimed 33.8, the average price paid since the Aug 18 spike.

queue.headline: $CTVA just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 77% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 278 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Healthcare & Biotech selling off, -2.0% avg on Wednesday
queue.body: $TWST -18.6% $TXG -17.5% $TEM -13.8% $GH -8.8% $CDNA -8.7% $MRNA -7.8% $ILMN -6.9% $SEER -6.0% Every name on the list is lower.
Director Jones Ginger M opened a new $ACCV position with a $180K purchase. The filing confirms the trade but gives no reason for it.

The next close decides whether the floor holds.
